tier_a_light.compression_profile: q4_0 uniform quantization + native multimodal + standard XRL artifacts

qwen25_coder_05b.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 0.5B (Test Scout / Hyperspeed Nano Candidate)
qwen25_coder_05b.description: Open XRL Adopted: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF/qwen2.5-coder-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf (0.46 GB). Candidate for XRLated-principia hyperdrive: fed XRL seeds it can act like a much larger model with infinite foveated memory.
qwen25_coder_05b.compression_profile: Q4_K_M uniform quantization + standard XRL artifacts

xrl_training.quality_gate: Fed XRLated principia, answers at >=90% of full-context baseline while context seed <=1.5K tokens

hymba_350m.name: Hymba 350M (Hybrid Mamba + Attention)
hymba_350m.description: NVIDIA Hymba-350M — hybrid Mamba SSM + full attention blocks. Sub-quadratic long context, strong recall over long sequences. Ideal XRL red-thread host.

xrl_training.quality_gate: Long-context XRL seed retention at >=90% of full-context baseline

hymba_350m_mamba2.name: Hymba 350M + Mamba2 SSD (Research Target)
hymba_350m_mamba2.description: Hymba hybrid with the SSM half upgraded to Mamba2 (SSD). Constant-size state = persistent XRL seed substrate (infinite memory).
hymba_350m_mamba2.compression_profile: mamba2-ssd persistent XRL seed state + attention recall

xrl_training.quality_gate: Persistent XRL seed state across sessions without re-feeding tokens

jamba_moe.name: Jamba MoE (Hybrid Mamba + MoE)
jamba_moe.description: AI21 Jamba — hybrid Mamba SSM + Mixture-of-Experts transformer. Long context (256K) with sparse expert routing. Candidate for high-capacity XRL compression with sub-quadratic cost.

xrl_training.quality_gate: 2.6x compression on 1B-2B models at MoQ 3.6-equivalent quality

jamba_moe_mini.name: Jamba-Mini MoE (Nano Hypermind Candidate)
jamba_moe_mini.description: Small hybrid Mamba+MoE for the hypermind draft-core. Sparse experts give capacity at nano size; Mamba gives long-context XRL seed handling.

xrl_training.quality_gate: Draft-core feeding at >=90% of full-context baseline

smollm2_135m_instruct.name: SmolLM2-135M-XRL (Trained — Nano Seed Trunk)
smollm2_135m_instruct.description: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct trained for 3 epochs on 22 <XRL-SEED> vocabulary tokens (vocab_size=49174, final_loss=0.1394). Active shared nano trunk on the Transformative State Drive (TSD).
smollm2_135m_instruct.compression_profile: dense-transformer base + XRL red-thread seed training

xrl_training.quality_gate: Fed XRLated principia, answers at >=90% of full-context baseline while context seed <=1.5K tokens

qwopus_9b_coder_xrlf.name: Qwopus 3.5 9B Coder MTP MoQ (.xrlf)
qwopus_9b_coder_xrlf.description: Local XRLF coding and reasoning specialist package in xrl_encoded/qwopus3.5-9b-coder-mtp-moq.xrlf (4.4 GB).
qwopus_9b_coder_xrlf.compression_profile: MoQ mixed quantization + MTP + XRLF container

tsd_xrlb_battery_pack.name: Transformative State Drive (TSD) 10x10 .xrlb Photonic Znake Battery Pack
tsd_xrlb_battery_pack.description: 10 sealed .xrlb Battery Beds on 250GB SSD (/mnt/foveai/motherboard/04_battery_beds) containing 100 Tetra-Pentahedral (TETRA_4/PENTA_5) specialist cells, 4 Heads, 10 Dirigents, and 16 Arms.
tsd_xrlb_battery_pack.compression_profile: TetraPak space-filling .xrlb battery beds + zero-copy mmap

mamba2_ssd_nano.name: Mamba2 SSD Nano (Persistent Seed State)
mamba2_ssd_nano.description: Pure Mamba2 (SSD) nano model. Constant-memory recurrent state is the native substrate for persistent, always-on XRL seeds — the closest match to 'infinite memory'.
mamba2_ssd_nano.compression_profile: mamba2-ssd persistent state + XRL seed native

xrl_training.quality_gate: Persistent XRL seed state with constant memory across long sessions
